newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico livestock report, feeder export price -USDA.
newsitem.headline: Mexico livestock report, feeder export price -USDA.

text.p: USDA reported Monday that around 1,000 head were exported into the United States at one crossing point Friday.

Through Nogales, Arizona, around 1,000 steer calves were sold at steady prices compared to last week. "Trade moderate, demand good. Bulk of supply consisted of steers weighing 300-500 lb," the USDA said.
Prices for head weighing 300-400 lb were 93-103 cents/lb and for 400-500 lb head at 83-93 cents/lb.
